scope: mesh-only before/after quality diagnostic; no field solving or numerical-quality qualification
quality: unchanged signed-condition/Jacobian schema and post-optimization strict-positive gate from parent; pre-optimization invalid metrics are observations only
repeatability_rule: exact pre-optimization quality, post-optimization quality, final ordered mesh, effective mesh policy and explicit optimizer across fresh local1/repeat1 processes
coordinate_extraction: re-fetch tags, coordinates and connectivity after optimization; no stale pre-optimization coordinate buffer
interpretation: one API call is not one internal optimizer iteration; generation, optimization and quality share the frozen worker watchdog
